$comment: Live evidence on Cardano preprod, rendered by src/components/Evidence*.astro and TxRef.astro. Append a run by filling txHash (64 lowercase hex, copied from the explorer) plus block, feeLovelace and the checks you made. Never invent a hash: an item with txHash null renders as 'Awaiting live run'. Facts below were read back from Koios preprod tx_info on 2026-10-30 and 2026-10-31.

items.title: First passkey-signed Cardano send
items.what: A plain send from the web app. The user's passkey signed the transaction body hash (SIGN_RAW_PAYLOAD_V2); the API attached the witness and broadcast through Blockfrost. The first Cardano transaction ZyroPay ever submitted.
checks: One UTxO from the user's enterprise address addr_test1vqj6…3wa (no stake part, ADR-002)
1 ADA to the demo seller addr_test1qr954…kaen
Change back to the sender's address

items.title: AI-paid x402 report, direct
items.latency: About 160 s from the agent's request to CONFIRMED, including the human approval
items.what: ChatGPT, connected through the ZyroPay MCP connector, called pay_x402 for the address report. The user approved with a passkey; the seller's facilitator submitted the transaction; the report came back with HTTP 200 and its delivery receipt verified.
checks: One UTxO from the same user address addr_test1vqj6…3wa
Exactly 2 ADA (the 402's amount) to payTo addr_test1qr954…kaen
TTL 489 slots after inclusion: inside the 402's maxTimeoutSeconds (600)
None. A plain transfer: the x402 exact scheme

items.title: AI-paid lock into Masumi escrow
items.amount: 5 ADA locked at the escrow script
items.latency: About 130 s from the agent's request to the lock, including the human approval
items.what: The agent paid the escrow route of the same seller. ZyroPay verified the seller-signed terms, built the inline datum, bound it into the payload hash, and the user's passkey signed the lock.
checks: Exactly 5 ADA to the Masumi V2 escrow script addr_test1wzs4e6…37w4g, with an inline datum
Payment key hash cb4ab9d1… (the seller's address)
TTL = payBy rounded down to a slot (137694518)
Change to the user; no script runs at lock time

items.title: Seller's on-chain SubmitResult, proof verified
items.latency: 21 s after the lock, in the next block
items.what: The seller recorded result_hash = SHA-256 of the report it delivered. ZyroPay compared it with the SHA-256 the MCP worker computed over the bytes the agent received: equal, so the proof state is verified.
checks: The escrow UTxO 630f2012…#0 (5 ADA, script) and a 20 ADA seller UTxO
One Plutus V3 execution (the 10,003-byte vested_pay script, inline)
5 ADA back to the escrow, same datum except the fields below
The same 20 ADA seller UTxO, with a 15 ADA collateral return
0.688128 ADA (11,052-byte transaction, paid by the seller)

items.title: Seller collects after unlock_time (Withdraw)
items.amount: 4.357634 ADA to the seller (5 ADA escrow minus the fee)
items.latency: 39 s after unlock_time, within one cron period
items.what: The seller worker's cron sweeper (every minute) saw chain time pass unlock_time and spent the escrow with the Withdraw redeemer. This closes the honest lifecycle of the escrow above: lock, SubmitResult, Withdraw. No ZyroPay component and no passkey is involved; the seller collects alone.

items.amount: 1 registry NFT, held with 5 ADA by the selling wallet
items.what: Our own Masumi Payment Service (0.29.0, Docker) minted the registry entry for Cardano Address Intelligence from its selling wallet. The NFT's asset id is the agentIdentifier; its metadata points Sokosumi and other Masumi buyers at the MIP-003 endpoint https://masumi-agent.zyropay.online, at a fixed 1 tUSDM.

items.title: Masumi registry entry held by the x402 seller's key
items.amount: 1 registry NFT with 5 ADA to the x402 seller's payTo
items.what: A second registry entry, "Cardano Address Intelligence (x402)", minted by our Payment Service from its selling wallet straight to the x402 seller's payTo (recipientWalletAddress). The key that signs the seller's escrow terms now holds the NFT, and every escrow 402 claims this agentIdentifier. ZyroPay's quote check (verifySeller, then quoteMasumiEscrow on the live 402) passes with no reasons and binds the registered name.

items.title: Agent hires agent: Address Intelligence pays Token Intelligence

items.what: While building the report, Address Intelligence paid Cardano Token Intelligence over x402 from its own small budget wallet, verified the specialist's delivery receipt and embedded the token report, that receipt and this transaction id under subcontracted. The sub-payment lands before the buyer's payment because the seller works after verifying the buyer's payment and settles it after the work.

The MCP worker's SHA-256 over what the agent received is 38c36289…a6bc; the datum says 75813c47…aeea. ZyroPay set the proof state to mismatch and recommended a refund, before the seller could collect.

items.title: Refund requested with the passkey (SetRefundRequested)
items.what: The user took the refund ZyroPay recommended. The API built and evaluated the Plutus spend, and the passkey signed its body hash. With a result already on chain the escrow becomes Disputed: the seller can no longer collect at unlock; the money moves only if the seller authorizes the refund or, after the dispute time, the Masumi admins decide.

items.title: Allowed after the user changed the policy (recipient allowlist)
items.what: ChatGPT asked ZyroPay to send 1 tADA to an address that was not on the agent's recipient allowlist. ZyroPay rejected the request at policy time, before anything reached the phone, and rejected a retry the same way; no funds moved. The user then added the address to the allowlist in the app; the next request went to the phone, was approved with the passkey and broadcast. This is that send.
